All 32768 duad masks and all 15 perfect matchings are explicitly enumerated, yielding 3264 maximal independent sets and exactly 90 minima of size 9. Every optimum is classified through 45 four-cycles and the complementary duad, and all one-for-one exchanges are checked, giving 45 disjoint edges. The second checker independently enumerates maximal independent sets in an explicitly verified isomorphic symplectic graph; all critical claims agree. No infinite extrapolation is asserted.

value.rationale: The (3,8)-cage is the smallest cubic girth-eight graph, making its minimum independent dominating sets an intrinsic extremal model. Unlike a routine size count, the complete C4 classification explains two natural symmetry orbits and a nontrivial optimum-state mobility phenomenon: each of 90 states has exactly one token-slide replacement, yielding 45 disjoint components. This sharply characterizes robustness/rigidity of local changes at the natural optimum and gives a meaningful finite benchmark for domination-set reconfiguration.
